name: French Onion Soup
description: A classic French onion soup made with caramelized onions, consomme, and topped with melted mozzarella cheese and croutons.
recipeIngredient: 4 Oxo cubes dissolved in 2 cups hot water

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter. Saute onions until transparent.
Add to Oxo, consomme and water. Simmer about 2 hours.
Put in onion soup bowls, add a slice of French bread on top of each one and add shredded mozzarella cheese sprinkled over each.
Put in oven at 350°F for 30 minutes.

keywords: French onion soup, caramelized onions, melted cheese

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and smooth asparagus soup made with canned asparagus, perfect for serving year-round with optional fresh garnishes.
recipeIngredient: 2 (12 oz) cans asparagus tips or cuttings

recipeInstructions.text: Chop onions and celery medium fine and sauté in butter until limp but not brown.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock (dissolve bouillon cubes in water) and stir until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then add canned asparagus including liquid and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Purée the soup in a blender and press through a sieve for a smooth texture.
To serve, bring soup to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in whipping cream.
Season to taste and keep warm over low heat without boiling.

_similar.keywords: asparagus soup, creamy soup, canned asparagus

_similar.name: Potato Soup
_similar.description: A creamy potato soup with carrots, onions, and bacon, finished with sour cream and butter for added richness.
recipeIngredient: 1 Oxo Chicken cube dissolved in 2 cups (8 oz) water + 1 cup water

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: potato soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce
